They play in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], following promotion from the [[Eerste Divisie]] in the [[2025–26 Eerste Divisie|2025–26 season]]. The club was for a time known as '''FC Den Haag''' ({{IPA|nl|ɛfˈseː dɛn ˈɦaːx|}}), with ADO representing the amateur branch of the club. Despite being from one of the traditional three large Dutch cities, it has not been able to match [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]], [[Feyenoord]] or [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]] in terms of success in the [[Eredivisie]] or in European competition. There is nonetheless a big rivalry with Ajax and Feyenoord. The [[Dutch language|Dutch]] words "Alles Door Oefening" translate into ''Everything Through Practice''."}}
